sentences.text:
This is a reference related statutory appeal under Land Acquisition Act by the appellant whose ownership land measuring 02 kanals 07 marlas 08 sarsai in village Levdoora, tehsil Dooru, district Anantnag was acquired for construction of railway line by recourse of land acquisition proceeds commenced in March 2003 under the J&K land Acquisition Act, Svt. 1990 culminating in final award dated 20.03.2005 by the Collector Land Acquisition, Anantnag awarding compensation @
Rs. 2,72,500 per kanal with 15% jabrana.
2.

The appellant feeling aggrieved of extent of land shown acquired and quantum of compensation awarded and non-compensation of apple trees, 8 willow & 50 poplar trees came to seek reference under Section 18 of the J&K Land Acquisition Act, Svt. 1990 on file no. 06/Reference of the Court of Principal District Judge, Anantnag instituted on 13.05.2008 and disposed of vide award judgment dated 14.12.2023.
3.

entities.text: Court of Principal District Judge, Anantnag
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The Court of Principal District Judge, Anantnag came to enhance compensation assessed from Rs.
2,72,500/- per kanal to Rs. 07 lac per kanal.

In addition, the reference Court has also awarded Ghulam Nabi Parray vs Collector Land Acquisition Anantnag ... on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/48957415/
1 amount of Rs. 4,73,272/- as compensation for loss and damages to trees.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Aggrieved of said award of the Principal District Judge, Anantnag, the appellant-owner expropriated in this statutory appeal claiming that his acquired land is 3.8 kanals under khasra numbers 111-min, 113-min & 114-min whereas the reference Court has returned finding of land acquired to be 02 kanals 07 marlas 08 sarsai.

Further being pleaded is that compensation ought to have been assessed at rupees 10 lac per kanal instead of Rs. 7 lac per kanal and damage to trees ought to have been for rupees 20 lacs instead of Rs. 4,73,272/-.
Appellant to furnish registered postal cover for service upon respondents within a period of 07 days, whereupon the Registrar Judicial, Srinagar shall issue notice to the respondents.

7. Send for the record of reference Court of Principal District Judge, Anantnag on file no.
06/Reference titled "Gh. Nabi Parray Vs. Collector Land Acquisition Anantnag"
8.
